blocks.text: The negative ELBO adds reconstruction cost and beta-weighted KL for each example. The task is: Compute the negative Bernoulli VAE ELBO: summed per-example reconstruction BCE plus beta times latent KL, then average over batch.

The inputs are `reconstruction_logits`, `targets`, `mu`, `log_variance`, `beta`. Keep their roles separate while you trace the solution. The animation follows the supplied implementation, so every highlighted operation connects to code you can inspect.

A useful test changes one condition while holding the remaining inputs fixed. Compare the output shape, state transition, valid edges, selected tokens, or returned status. This isolates the reason for the change.
